usedFor: Peanutsquare holds the business records, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computers after “When a new payment is received”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new payment is received” in Peanutsquare, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A recorded payment is a clear event, so a command on your computers can follow it.

watchOut: Peanutsquare triggers are polling, so “Trigger Command” runs after a scheduled check, not when the payment lands.
